name: Namely
summary: Namely is an HR platform with four packages, NamelyNow, NamelyPlus, NamelyPlus People and NamelyComplete. Only NamelyNow has a published price, starting at $9 per employee a month. Its onboarding page covers automated task checklists, document management with e-signature and a tracked I-9 workflow.

facts.text: The benefits page lists open enrollment via mobile or desktop, electronic carrier connections, built-in ACA reporting and compliance management, and says Namely automates eligibility rules, deductions and data flows.
The package comparison table shows the benefits administration module starting at NamelyPlus, not in the $9 NamelyNow package; the table's icons carry no text labels.
The onboarding page describes automated tasks, reminders and hire-date triggers, with tasks assigned by role and plans that can be grouped by start date.

The onboarding page says forms, tax documents and training materials are gathered in one system with document management and e-signatures, and that the I-9 workflow adds secure e-signing with tracking.
The onboarding page does not use the term new hire portal. It describes mobile access that lets remote new hires complete their setup from a phone, which is the closest match to that test.
The pricing page says contract terms run from month to month up to 3 years, and that managed services are priced by complexity, modules and services required after a diagnostic.

plans.name: NamelyNow
plans.notes: Listed as starting at $9. No minimum employee count or fee is stated

hiddenCosts: Only the entry package has a published price, and it is a starting price.
Managed payroll, benefits and other services have no listed prices.

contract.cancellation: The pricing page offers flexible contract terms from month to month up to 3 years and does not state cancellation conditions.
